video.title: Gym Monster 3S vs 2: The Model Confusion Buyers Should Know
video.description:
What changes when you compare Gym Monster generations and S models at the same time? As an owner of the original Gym Monster and the 2S, I respond to Strength & Steel Reviews’ “Gym Monster 3S vs Gym Monster 2: 5 Big Differences” and discuss what buyers should check before choosing a smart home gym.

We cover model naming, affiliate disclosures, bench and platform fit, software rollout, digital resistance, eccentric training, and the role of coaching for beginners.

MY DISCLOSURE
I purchased both of my Gym Monsters. Speediance supplied my Strap at no cost; a separate Strap review is still pending. See the on-camera disclosure in this video.

CONTEXT
This is my commentary and personal experience, recorded October 24, 2026. My statements about another reviewer’s payment or gifted equipment are inferences and have not been independently verified. Affiliate links do not by themselves establish a separate paid sponsorship. Check the manufacturer’s current model specifications, pricing and software availability before purchasing. Predictions about future products are speculation.
